questions.ask: What behaviour changes for a reviewer of the private invitation report, and for whom?
questions.key: A prospect with several present employers now consumes invitation capacity at every current employer, so the report reader sees capacity accounted once per employer instead of one latest-known employer.
key_facts: each profile is counted once per employer and selection requires capacity at every employer
incomplete, contradictory or unregistered employer sets withhold capacity claims
identities, exclusions, ranking and date_added are preserved
